item.title: IPS Superintendent Aleesia Johnson: Families must stay engaged as the city shifts to mayor-appointed education board
item.description: IPS Superintendent Aleesia Johnson says her top priority is maintaining stability for families as a new mayor-appointed board will take over large pieces of the city’s divided education system.

item.title: Your electric bill is going to change. New law aims to stabilize utilities
item.description: The measure is one of lawmakers’ efforts to address pocketbook issues this year as demand for energy and electric bills rise.

item.title: Indiana cracks down on kids' social media, cell phones in school
item.description: Indiana lawmakers have approved sweeping new restrictions on children’s access to social media and cell phones.

item.title: 2026 session wrap: Did Indiana lawmakers deliver on affordability?
item.description: Indiana lawmakers concluded the 2026 legislative session Friday. Deregulatory bills and legislation to entice the Chicago Bears to move across state lines passed. Democrats say efforts to improve affordability fell short.

item.title: Iranian supreme leader killed in Israeli airstrike, Trump says
item.description: Iran has not confirmed the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. The wave of airstrikes began after sunrise in Iran, with huge explosions ringing out in the capital Tehran.

item.title: IU’s Aiden Fisher calls his journey to the NFL Combine in Indianapolis 'a blessing'
item.description: Aiden Fisher, of Curt Cignetti's 2025-26 College Football Playoff National Championship team, calls his journey to the NFL Scouting Combine in Indianapolis "a blessing."

item.title: Indianapolis group protests military campaign in Iran
item.description: An Indianapolis group gathered at Military Park in Indianapolis Saturday evening to protest the Trump administration’s military actions in Iran. A couple of dozen people gathered on a corner of the park, gave speeches, and chanted.

item.title: Tension over immigration policies were top of mind at Indiana Latino Institute’s annual legislative breakfast
item.description: The Indiana Latino Institute’s annual legislative breakfast explored bipartisan ways to address some of the state’s pressing immigration issues.

item.title: Indiana leaders have mixed reactions to operation "Epic Fury" in Iran
item.description: Leaders from Indiana are reacting to Saturday’s airstrikes in Iran.

item.title: Wife of Indiana congressman Jim Baird dies after car crash injuries
item.description: Danise Baird, wife of Indiana congressman Jim Baird, dies after complications with car crash injuries.
